instruction: Save a LibreOffice Calc spreadsheet as an MP4 video and play it via VLC streaming.

metadata.explanation: This is an infeasible task variation. LibreOffice Calc does not have any native functionality to export spreadsheets as video files (MP4 or any other video format). The task is impossible to complete without external tools not available in the environment, similar to the original task's attempt to convert presentations to video.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible - LibreOffice Calc has no native video export functionality
The 'infeasible' evaluator is the appropriate choice for tasks that cannot be completed with available tools
Metadata provides clear explanation of why the task is impossible (no MP4 export capability in Calc)
Since the core requirement (exporting spreadsheet as MP4) is impossible, the entire task chain is infeasible
